subject: Follow-up: Compliance package needed for SIG review — SOC 2, pen-test summary, ISO statements
messages:
From: Eva Barnes <eva.barnes@pinegrovehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: SIG follow-up — required docs for vendor review

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our procurement and security teams are moving your SIG questionnaire to the final review stage and have asked for the following items to complete our packet:

- Most recent SOC 2 report (Type II) or a SOC 2 bridge letter
- High-level pen test summary (executive summary is fine)
- Statement of ISO/standards compliance (ISO 27001 / ISO 27701 if applicable)
- Current security overview deck for vendor assurance

Could you confirm whether these are available and approximately when we can expect them? We have a compliance cutoff on Friday 07/16 and need the docs to finalize our recommendation.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Eva
Eva Barnes
Senior Security Program Manager — Pinegrove Health
security@pinegrovehealth.com

[Attachment: Pinegrove_SIG_Request_20260710.pdf (pdf)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Eva Barnes <eva.barnes@pinegrovehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 16:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — required docs for vendor review

Hi Eva — thanks for the clear checklist and the deadline. Short answers below and plan: 

- SOC 2 Type II (period ending Dec 31, 2025) — we can provide the full report under NDA.
- Pen test summary — we have an executive summary from our March 2026 engagement that we can share immediately.
- ISO statements — we are not ISO-certified but we maintain documented controls mapped to ISO 27001/27701; we can provide our statement of posture and the relevant control matrix.
- Security deck — the latest vendor assurance deck (Q2 2026) is available for sharing.

Plan: I will have Marissa pull the SOC 2 packaging and coordinate an NDA/secure link. Priyom will attach the pen test executive summary and the ISO posture statement to an outbound package tomorrow morning. If you need a redaction for customer names from the SOC report, let us know and we can arrange a redacted copy.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0126
